title: Cell Variety Lab
objectives: Match cell shapes to their jobs
Know the smallest and largest cells
Bust the 'bigger animal = bigger cells' myth

stages.title: The Shapeless Blobs
stages.narration: Necrosis melts cells into blobs. Restore their shapes and sizes to free piece 3!

steps.text: Cells lose their shapes and jobs.
Anaya: 'Each cell shape has a purpose!'

stages.title: Shape Fits the Job
stages.prompt: Match each cell to why it has its shape.

tasks.label: Carries signals over long distances
tasks.explain: Nerve cells are long and branched.

tasks.label: Flows through vessels carrying oxygen
tasks.explain: Red blood cells are round flexible discs.

tasks.label: Contracts and relaxes to move you
tasks.explain: Muscle cells are long and spindle-shaped.

stages.title: True or False: Size & Number
stages.prompt: Decide whether each statement is true or false.

tasks.label: The ostrich egg is the largest single cell
Elephants have bigger cells than mice
tasks.explain: They have MORE cells, not bigger ones.

tasks.label: Most cells need a microscope to be seen

stages.title: Mini-Boss: Reshape the Cells
stages.prompt: Score 80% to restore every cell and grab piece 3!

questions.q: A nerve cell is long so it can…
questions.explain: Its shape carries messages over distance.

questions.q: The largest single cell is the…
questions.explain: The ostrich egg is the largest.

questions.q: What gives a cell its shape?
questions.explain: The membrane (and wall in plants) gives shape.
Too small to see without a microscope.

stages.title: Cell of Life: Piece 3 Restored!
messages: 🏅 You earned the Variety Voyager badge
🧬 Cell of Life: 3 of 8 pieces restored
Every cell snaps back into its proper shape!
